column2: It will often be beneficial to allow a graphic display to appear the same on

column1: a composite monitor as it does on an RGB monitor.  The following Basic routine,
which will convert an RGB color code into its closest similar composite color code,
can be used.  Since RGB colors are derived in a different manner than composite
colors, no conversion will be exact.
